Methods and interpretation

PIP is marginal inclusion probability across active components; alpha is a component probability. Credible sets use the recorded posterior coverage and LD purity filters. Effective candidate counts summarize posterior concentration, not causal counts. ELBO stopping, posterior stability and refinement improvement answer different questions. Refinement compares restored-prior candidates against the same original model objective. An unsuccessful attempted search does not establish global optimality. LD diagnostics assess summary-statistics compatibility under their recorded model and do not automatically correct alleles or filter variants. Missing or unassessed information is not a passing check. Sensitivity results remain distinct posteriors and are never averaged. Genotype correlation between representative variants does not by itself establish whether effects are conditionally distinguishable in the fitted model. Neither CS count nor component matching confirms the number of causal variants.

Machine-readable evidence references

Start with analysis_summary.json; query evidence.json using data paths or stable fact IDs. All 87183 scalar facts remain in that file and are not duplicated into this page. No browser scripts or remote resources are required.

Lossless saved structure: analysis.json with arrays.npz. Open index.html locally and keep its directory together to retain export links. GitHub file pages do not execute this report.
